title: Source/rights publication gate final in backend/history_models.py and backend/routers/heritage.py

implementation_summary.goal: Enforce strict source/rights publication gate final across all 9 Urns & 162 Motifs. Sampling verification, completeness reporting, atomic claim retraction, and media rights revocation with immediate anti-stale cache header enforcement.

retraction_governance.claim_retraction: Atomic demotion of wrong or contested claims to 'rejected' or 'disputed' with is_current=False and immutable historical_content_audit_log entry.
retraction_governance.media_revocation: Immediate invalidation of revoked media assets with anti-stale headers ('no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate'), ledger recording in asset_cache_revocations, and edge CDN cache purge.
retraction_governance.public_isolation: Public endpoints strictly filter out unapproved, draft, disputed, or retracted claims and revoked media assets.

negative_abuse_verified.statement: Public random audit verified 0 unapproved claims or revoked media assets are visible across public routes.
